notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content:
[h2]Small bug fix[/h2]

Thanks to the community feedback received, our first round of bug fixing has gone into the game.

[list]
[*] Prevent player falling through the ground near the graveyard.
[*] Recover existing save files for players that have experienced this issues.
[*] Preventive work to stop this occurring in other places.
[/list]

Looking forward, we will focus on improving the documentation and explanations in the puzzles and any other reported bugs.

Thanks for the community feedback, please keep providing your feedback as this helps us improve!

notes.title: Code Wizard Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Ready to learn?[/h2]
Thank you for all of the support and enthusiasm over the last several months. I'm happy to announce that Code Wizard is now available!

[h2]What next?[/h2]
While you're improving your coding skills, we're eager to improve our games. We would welcome any feedback in the community hub (bugs, gameplay issues, difficulty, or anything else you can think of).

We'll use this feedback to improve this game, and apply it to any future coding games going forward.
